contacts.emailBody:
Dear Adecco Austria Team,

My name is Kálmán Tamás Krisztián and I am a full stack developer based in Budapest, Hungary. I am currently looking for a new opportunity and I am reaching out in case you have an open developer position or an upcoming project that matches my profile.

My core stack is TypeScript with React and Next.js, Angular on the front end, and Node.js with NestJS on the backend; on the database side I mainly work with MongoDB. I have taken several products from specification through to production — in healthcare, travel, real estate and e-commerce — so I move between domains and codebases fairly quickly. I have worked closely with designers, and it matters to me that an interface not only works but also looks the way the designer intended.

I also enjoy AI-assisted coding, because it gives me a better overview of the products I build. It lets me work more efficiently, including on larger, more structured projects.

I have attached my CV. To be upfront about the setup: I am based in Budapest and am looking for fully remote work, or an arrangement where I travel to the office a few times a year — I am not planning to relocate to Austria. Budapest is in the same time zone and a short flight or train ride away, so occasional on-site days are easy to arrange. I am an EU citizen, so there are no work permit formalities involved, and my working language is English.

I would be happy to talk if there is a current opening.

GitHub: github.com/tamaskk

Portfolio: tamaskk.com

Best regards,

Kálmán Tamás Krisztián

Kedves Abesse Csapat!

Kálmán Tamás Krisztián vagyok, full stack fejlesztő Budapestről. Jelenleg új lehetőséget keresek, és megkerestelek arra az esetre, ha van nálatok nyitott fejlesztői pozíció vagy induló projekt, amihez illik a profilom.

A fő stackem TypeScript, React és Next.js, Angular, valamint Node.js és NestJS a backend oldalon, adatbázis oldalon pedig legfőképp MongoDB-t használok. Több terméket vittem végig a specifikációtól az élesítésig — egészségügyi, utazási, ingatlanpiaci és e-kereskedelmi területen egyaránt —, így viszonylag gyorsan váltok domaint és kódbázist. Designerekkel szorosan együttműködve dolgoztam, és fontos számomra, hogy egy felület ne csak működjön, hanem úgy is nézzen ki, ahogy a tervező elképzelte.

Az AI-támogatott kódolást is nagyon szeretem, mivel így jobban átlátom a termékeket. Ezáltal könnyebben tudok dolgozni, jobban strukturált projekteken is.

My name is Kálmán Tamás Krisztián and I am a full stack developer based in Budapest, Hungary. I am reaching out in case you place candidates who work remotely from Europe.

My core stack is TypeScript throughout: React and Next.js on the front end, Angular, and Node.js with NestJS on the backend, with MongoDB as my main database. I have taken several products from specification through to production — in healthcare, travel, real estate and e-commerce — including AI-based systems for private clinics and a mobile app that passed 100,000 downloads.

I also work extensively with AI-assisted coding, which gives me a better overview of the products I build and makes it easier to work on large, structured projects.

To be upfront about the practical side: I am an EU citizen based in Budapest and I do not hold US work authorization. I am therefore looking for fully remote roles or contract work — either through an Employer of Record arrangement, or as an independent contractor through my own registered business in Hungary, which simplifies the paperwork considerably on your side. Budapest overlaps with US East Coast mornings, and I am used to working across time zones.

If you work with clients who are open to EU-based remote talent, I would be glad to send my CV and discuss further.

GitHub: github.com/tamaskk

Portfolio: tamaskk.com

Best regards,

Kálmán Tamás Krisztián

kalman.tamaskrisztian@gmail.com · +36 70 315 7553

My name is Kálmán Tamás Krisztián and I am a full stack developer based in Budapest, Hungary. I am reaching out in case you place candidates who work remotely from Europe.

My core stack is TypeScript throughout: React and Next.js on the front end, Angular, and Node.js with NestJS on the backend, with MongoDB as my main database. I have taken several products from specification through to production — in healthcare, travel, real estate and e-commerce — including AI-based systems for private clinics and a mobile app that passed 100,000 downloads.

I also work extensively with AI-assisted coding, which gives me a better overview of the products I build and makes it easier to work on large, structured projects.

To be upfront about the practical side: I am an EU citizen based in Budapest and I do not hold US work authorization. I am therefore looking for fully remote roles or contract work — either through an Employer of Record arrangement, or as an independent contractor through my own registered business in Hungary, which simplifies the paperwork considerably on your side. Budapest overlaps with US East Coast mornings, and I am used to working across time zones.

If you work with clients who are open to EU-based remote talent, I would be glad to send my CV and discuss further.

GitHub: github.com/tamaskk

Portfolio: tamaskk.com

Best regards,

Kálmán Tamás Krisztián

contacts.emailSubject: Full stack fejlesztői jelentkezés – Kálmán Tamás Krisztián
contacts.emailBody:
Kedves Gellért!

Kálmán Tamás Krisztián vagyok, full stack fejlesztő Budapestről. Láttam, hogy egy IT-cég vezetője vagy, ezért közvetlenül írok: érdeklődnék, hogy van-e nálatok nyitott fejlesztői pozíció, vagy várható-e a közeljövőben.

A stackem TypeScript végig: React, Next.js és Angular frontenden, Node.js és NestJS backenden, adatbázis oldalon főként MongoDB. Több terméket vittem végig a specifikációtól az élesítésig — egészségügyi, utazási, ingatlanpiaci és e-kereskedelmi területen —, többek között AI-alapú rendszereken magánklinikáknak és egy 100 000+ letöltésű mobilalkalmazáson.

Az AI-támogatott kódolás a napi munkafolyamatom része — így jobban átlátom a termékeket, és struktúráltabb projekteken is gyorsabban haladok. Azt is fontosnak tartom hozzátenni, hogy a generált kódért a fejlesztő felel: nálam semmi nem megy be felülvizsgálat és tesztelés nélkül. Ha van nálatok nyitott fejlesztői pozíció vagy induló projekt, szívesen küldök önéletrajzot és beszélgetnék róla. Ha nem én vagyok a megfelelő ember, azt is megértem — köszönöm, hogy időt szántál rá.

GitHub: github.com/tamaskk · Portfólió: tamaskk.com

Üdvözlettel, Kálmán Tamás Krisztián · kalman.tamaskrisztian@gmail.com · +36 70 315 7553

contacts.emailBody:
Hi Julieta,

My name is Kálmán Tamás Krisztián and I am a full stack developer based in Budapest. I am currently looking for a new opportunity, and since you work in recruitment, I thought I would reach out.

My stack is TypeScript throughout: React, Next.js and Angular on the front end, Node.js and NestJS on the backend, with MongoDB as my main database. I have worked in healthcare, travel, real estate and e-commerce — including AI-based systems for private clinics and a mobile app that passed 100,000 downloads.

I also enjoy AI-assisted coding, because it gives me a better overview of the products I build and makes it easier to work on structured projects.

I am interested in mid-level full stack and Forward Deployed Engineer roles, in Budapest or remote within the EU.

If you have a role in your pipeline that matches my profile, I would be glad to send my CV.

GitHub: github.com/tamaskk

Portfolio: tamaskk.com

Best,

Kálmán Tamás Krisztián

contacts.emailBody:
Hi Anna,

My name is Kálmán Tamás Krisztián and I am a full stack developer based in Budapest. I am currently looking for a new opportunity, and since you work in recruitment, I thought I would reach out.

My stack is TypeScript throughout: React, Next.js and Angular on the front end, Node.js and NestJS on the backend, with MongoDB as my main database. I have worked in healthcare, travel, real estate and e-commerce — including AI-based systems for private clinics and a mobile app that passed 100,000 downloads.

I also enjoy AI-assisted coding, because it gives me a better overview of the products I build and makes it easier to work on structured projects.

I am interested in mid-level full stack and Forward Deployed Engineer roles, in Budapest or remote within the EU.

If you have a role in your pipeline that matches my profile, I would be glad to send my CV.

GitHub: github.com/tamaskk

Portfolio: tamaskk.com

Best,

Kálmán Tamás Krisztián

contacts.emailBody:
Hi Anna,

My name is Kálmán Tamás Krisztián and I am a full stack developer based in Budapest. I am currently looking for a new opportunity, and since you work in recruitment, I thought I would reach out.

My stack is TypeScript throughout: React, Next.js and Angular on the front end, Node.js and NestJS on the backend, with MongoDB as my main database. I have worked in healthcare, travel, real estate and e-commerce — including AI-based systems for private clinics and a mobile app that passed 100,000 downloads.

I also enjoy AI-assisted coding, because it gives me a better overview of the products I build and makes it easier to work on structured projects.

I am interested in mid-level full stack and Forward Deployed Engineer roles, in Budapest or remote within the EU.

If you have a role in your pipeline that matches my profile, I would be glad to send my CV.

GitHub: github.com/tamaskk

Portfolio: tamaskk.com

Best,

Dear Jason,

My name is Kálmán Tamás Krisztián and I am a full stack developer based in Budapest. I saw that you lead an IT company, so I am writing to you directly: I wanted to ask whether you currently have an open developer position, or expect one in the near future.

My stack is TypeScript throughout: React, Next.js and Angular on the front end, Node.js and NestJS on the backend, with MongoDB as my main database. I have taken several products from specification through to production — in healthcare, travel, real estate and e-commerce — including AI-based systems for private clinics and a mobile app that passed 100,000 downloads.

AI-assisted coding is part of my daily workflow — it gives me a better overview of the products I build and helps me move faster on larger, structured projects. I would add that the developer remains responsible for generated code: nothing goes in without review and testing.

To be upfront about the practical side: I am an EU citizen based in Budapest and I do not hold US work authorization, so I am looking for fully remote work — either through an Employer of Record arrangement, or as a contractor through my own registered business in Hungary. Budapest overlaps with US East Coast mornings. If you have something that might fit, I would be glad to send my CV.

GitHub: github.com/tamaskk · Portfolio: tamaskk.com

Best regards, Kálmán Tamás Krisztián · kalman.tamaskrisztian@gmail.com · +36 70 315 7553
